Find the equation of the tangent hyperplane to the hypersurface w=sin⁡(xyz) at the point (1,1,π,0).

a
πx+πy+z+w−3π=0
b
πx+πy−z+w−π=0
c
πx−πy+z+w−π=0
d
πx−πy−z+w+π=0
e
πx+πy+z−w+3π=0
